name: Cristiano Ronaldo
about: Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro (born 5 February 1985) is widely regarded as one of the greatest football players of all time. The Portuguese forward captains both the Saudi Pro League club Al-Nassr and the Portugal national team.

sections.title: Current Career & Statistics
content: Total Career Goals: 985 official goals in 1,343 senior appearances.
Current Club Form: Leading the line for Al-Nassr with 8 goals in 9 matches.
International Record: All-time top scorer in men's international football history with 146 goals.

name: Shanaya Kapoor
about: Shanaya Kapoor (born 3 November 1999) is an Indian actress, model, and entrepreneur. She is the daughter of Bollywood actor-producer Sanjay Kapoor and jewelry designer Maheep Kapoor.

sections.title: Film & Web Career
content: Theatrical Debut (2025): Starred in Aankhon Ki Gustaakhiyan opposite Vikrant Massey.
Streaming Success (2026): Found success on Netflix with the survival thriller Tu Yaa Main.
Upcoming Projects: Student of the Year: After Dark and a zombie comedy with Tiger Shroff.

sections.title: Family Connections
content: Paternal Uncles: Anil Kapoor and Boney Kapoor.
Cousins: Sonam Kapoor, Janhvi Kapoor, Khushi Kapoor, and Arjun Kapoor.
